rationale: The plan correctly identifies the data as RSEM expected counts, states that the tximport length offset is lost without the genes.results files, rounds for DESeq2 and never substitutes TPM/FPKM, and models the unpaired 6-vs-6 single-batch contrast with ~condition, control as reference, size factors inside the model, BH at 0.05 and apeglm; it does not, however, explicitly request the missing genes.results files as the reference expects. QC is thorough (library sizes, PCA, correlation, RLE) with an explicit retain-plus-sensitivity policy for sample_01, and the filter (>=10 in >=6 samples) is justified by the smaller group size. The |LFC|>1 cut is applied post hoc rather than via lfcThreshold in the test. Enrichment was not requested; the added GSEA is well specified (full ranked list, Wald statistic, size window, BH, seed) but gives no collection version. Reporting covers method, design, thresholds, gene counts and caveats but lists packages without versions.
